summary: The requirement document describes an online platform where small business borrowers of an NBFC apply for loans, verify identity, upload documents and sign agreements online. The credit team reviews and approves applications with a scoring rules engine and a credit bureau check. Borrowers also set up automatic EMI collection and pay overdue EMIs online.

evidence.quote: Applicants shall apply for a loan online through a web form and an Android and iOS app, and save a draft to finish later.
